TC-08/S07.title: Who can send to whom / who can read it
TC-08/S07.detail: Local 8b4be94a: 'a recipient is found by exact email, never by listing accounts' (new title on #104: replaces the picker title), 'a handoff cannot go to yourself, to a non-account, or be empty', 'a handoff is invisible to anyone who is neither sender nor recipient', 'a mistyped handoff id reads as not available rather than failing': 4/4 passed; tripwire no model call.
